An experimental machine, tested in absolute secrecy as part of the Gundam Development Project conducted by the Federation Forces and Anaheim Electronics.
It was developed as the mobile suit unit of the mobile weapon Dendrobium.
To help it combine with the armed base Orchis, it was given tail binders to improve its handling and mobility, and its cockpit used a panoramic monitor and linear seat to help the pilot control its vast array of weapons.
It also featured folding arms, necessary for it to work in tandem with the armed base Orchis.
Because it took a long time to resupply the armed base, the mobile suit unit was outfitted with the capabilities to hold its own in solo space combat.

An experimental machine that combined the features of a mobile suit and mobile armor, tested in absolute secrecy as part of the Gundam Development Project conducted by the Federation Forces and Anaheim Electronics.
It was loaded with every weapon imaginable, in an effort to fulfill the Gundam Development Project's concept of "history's strongest mobile weapon."
Because it was assumed that this machine would be used mainly to defend bases in space, the armed base Orchis was developed into a massive weapon storage unit.
It was highly mobile thanks to its huge propellant supply, and its armament included a mega beam cannon with incredible firepower.
Combined with a beam weapon-nullifying I-Field generator, these gave it overwhelming combat capabilities.

An advanced version of the AEUG's Hyaku-Shiki, with increased thrust and lighter weight.
The Hyaku-Shiki's wing binder backpack was replaced with drum-shaped directional thrusters and high-mobility vernier stabilizers, improving its mobility and maneuverability.
The machine's armament is also supplemented with fixed weapons such as pulse laser cannons and beam gatling guns, which can be attached to shoulder hardpoints.
As a result, it boasts high offensive strength and extensibility.

A form of the AEUG mobile suit Hyaku-Shiki Kai with extra armor.
Developed to enhance the base machine's armor and weaponry, it is equipped with multiple high-output beam weapons and projectile weapons.
It also has newly designed armor, and reflector panels that serve as an anti-beam defense mechanism.
It minimizes the decrease in mobility by adding thrusters to various parts, and can function as a standard Hyaku-Shiki Kai when the armor is purged.

The RX-104FF Penelope had been deployed by Kenneth as a trump card to eradicate Mafty.
TX-ff104, commonly referred to as the Alyzeus, was hastily assembled to be used by Lane Aim as a machine to train for high-speed flight while in Flight Form until the Penelope was deployed.

A prototype mass-production model of the RX-93 Nu-Gundam.
Its machine specs are approximately 80% of Nu-Gundam's.
Minor changes were made for this machine to function as the foundation of Alyzeus, and the block structure of the head part and groin joints were changed.

A prototype mobile suit developed as a testbed by S.N.R.I., a proponent of mobile suit miniaturization.
The F90 forms the base of the machine, and despite specializing in melee combat, it only comes equipped with basic weaponry, allowing excellent mobility.
However, by attaching and detaching various mission packs to the hardpoints covering its body, it can respond flexibly to a wide range of missions.

One of the F90 variants.
Def Stallion equipped the mobile suit with every last spare optional armament for the final battle against the Mars Independent Zeon Forces.
Combining the loadouts of the Assault, Support, and Destroy types, it is capable of responding to a wide range of combat situations.

The L (Long Range) Type is a long-range design for sniping from extreme distances.
Its defining feature is the extended long rifle supported by a specialized backpack and hardpoints on the waist.
The incorporation of beam-guided I-Field generation technology into the barrel resulted in a revolutionary system capable of firing both beams and projectiles.
With the diffusion rate reduced to a minimum, the rifle fires a beam that boasts an effective range of over 100 km, comparable to the distance between colonies within a Side.
The rifle projectiles, meanwhile, were fitted with vernier pellets on the shank and base. By detonating the projectiles after firing them, their trajectories can be altered, making them semi-guided.
Memory chips installed in the tips can be programmed with trajectories, enabling enemies and bases outside the direct line of fire to be targeted.
In addition, missile launchers were mounted on both arms.
A composite optical sensor for precision targeting was mounted on the left shoulder, while a thermoscope was mounted on the backpack.
The equipment was configured to ensure accurate sniping from a long range.

The I (Intercept) Type, a pack developed for the F90 and F90II, has been designed around the concepts of interception and pursuit.
Reportedly developed alongside the F90II, its use on the mobile suit has been confirmed in actual deployment.
The most prominent feature is the large flight shield that enables solo flight. When in use, it deploys underneath the machine and functions as a sub-flight system.
Additionally, thrust-boosting units were mounted on the legs to improve acceleration during flight, achieving stable flight performance.
The loadout features a specialized beam lancer.
While it can be used as a melee weapon, including thrusting with the lengthy lancer section, it was also designed to fire diffuse beams.
By pairing the solo flight capability of the flight shield with the wide attack range of the beam lancer, the design allows for lightning-fast hit-and-run tactics.

One of the GAT-X series Mobile Suits, the Duel Gundam was a joint development between the Atlantic Federation and Morgenroete, Inc. in the fight against the ZAFT's Mobile Suits.
The GAT-X series is loaded with the latest in experimental Beam Weapon tech to offer performance that puts the ZAFT's mass-produced varieties to shame.
Special Phase Shift Armor offers near-total immunity to physical damage while active but shifts down once the battery's energy runs out, deactivating and returning the armor to its original gray color.
A standard suit designed with flexibility in mind, it elects to keep its weapons simple with Beam Sabers and Beam Rifles.
Being the nearest of the GAT-X series to completion, it was used as a base model for later suits.

A Duel Gundam with additional equipment.
The Assault Shroud refers to the ZAFT-developed equipment add-on system made for the GINN and modified for use with the Duel Gundam.
It comes equipped with additional armor for increased defense, along with shoulder-mounted Railgun "Shiva" and a 5-Tube Missile Pod for enhanced offensive power.
Though the extra equipment does add weight, the addition of more thrusters and stabilizing nozzle covers offer the lowest possible compromise to maneuverability and balance.

The Seravee Gundam when using the GNHW/B (GN Heavy Weapon/Beam) weapons loadout.
Beyond the additional GN Cannons, its shoulders and legs have been installed with new GN Condenser-equipped GN Field generators, improving its offensive and defensive capabilities alike.
The Seravee Gundam received these new weapons in the lead- up to the final battle against the Innovators and A-LAWS, where it fought against Revive Revival in the Gadessa.

The Seraphim Gundam when using the Seravee Gundam's GNHW/B (GN Heavy Weapon/Beam) weapons loadout.
The Seravee Gundam's additional equipment like the GN Verniers and hip GN Cannons are connected to the Seraphim Gundam in backpack mode, allowing the Seraphim Gundam to use them even when separated.
